Code review of dispatch gate at EmissionEntryForm.js lines 3857-4010 confirms C7 is explicitly skipped (legacy path preserved) and biogenic falls through (legacy path preserved). The 3 categories actually exercised covered all three payload-shape contracts (Scope 1, Scope 2 generic, Scope 3 flat-spend) so the broadened dispatch is byte-shape correct for those contracts.
